title: Pug's Cookable Eggs
description: This datapack adds cookable eggs. Although it takes longer to cook then other foods.
body:
This datapack adds, cookable, smokable, and (camp)fire-able eggs. Although it takes longer to cook then other foods. The eggs turn into cooked chicken because it doesn't add any items. That's it, just cookable eggs.

Feel free to add to any modpacks.
